title: Document safe retention of Wine test prefixes
changes: Define prefix-specific checks for completion, consumers, personal data, host links and host-visible activity before cleanup; preserve shared active prefixes.
validation: Inventoried 21 Wine prefixes without following links and reviewed completed workbench evidence and current ROM script references; a sandbox-only process list could not establish host idleness.
limitations: No Wine prefix was removed; inventory estimates allocated blocks and may double-count hard links, and extension checks alone cannot establish absence of private data.
